_extraction.source: in-game help/rules panel — DOM HTML pasted by Paulo from live tab
notes: Numbers in the UI use comma as decimal separator (e.g. '0,7x'); converted to '.' here.
Cluster size tiers: 8, 9, 10, 11, 12+ (any cluster size >= 12 pays the 12+ tier).
Symbol paytable is IDENTICAL between base and bonus games for symbols 1-9, wild, and bonus (scatter pay).
Bonus game adds a 12th card: Multiplier (tumble_multiplier symbol with weighted multiplier values).
Bonus symbol behaviour differs by mode:
- Base game: 3/4/5/6 scatters trigger 8/10/12/14 free spins (initial bonus award).
- Bonus game: 3/4/5/6 scatters retrigger 3/5/8/10 ADDITIONAL respins (up to 3 retriggers per bonus).
Wild substitutes for any symbol except Bonus; no standalone payout.
Multiplier symbol UI percentages cross-check exactly against /api/v2/slots weights (weight/200 = UI %).

rules_tab.free_spins: Yes — triggered by 3+ scatter symbols. In the bonus game, landing bonus symbols can retrigger extra bonus rounds, up to 3 times per bonus game.
rules_tab.bonus_buys: Yes — first spin of a bought bonus game is purely cosmetic and does not produce clusters or wins. It shows a guaranteed bonus, so this initial spin isn't verifiable through the Provably Fair system.
rules_tab.tumbling: Yes — winning symbols disappear, symbols above drop down, new symbols drop in from the top. Continues while new wins land OR until max multiplier is reached.
rules_tab.wilds: Yes — wild substitutes for any symbol except Bonus and contributes to every cluster win.
rules_tab.multipliers: Bonus game only. When tumbling stops, all multiplier symbols on screen are summed and applied to that tumble round's total win.

wild.note: Substitutes for any symbol except Bonus; contributes to every cluster win. No standalone payout.
Substitutes for any symbol except Bonus; contributes to every cluster win. No standalone payout.

multiplier.note: Sticky multiplier symbol that drops in during free spins. After tumbling settles, all multiplier values on screen are summed and applied to the tumble round's total win.

consistency_check.multiplier_ui_vs_api: ALL 14 entries match exactly when API weight is divided by total weight (200). Confirms /api/v2/slots weights and UI-displayed weights are the same source.
consistency_check.symbol_paytable_base_vs_bonus: Symbols 1-9 paytable IDENTICAL across base and bonus modes. Bonus mode only adds the Multiplier sticky symbol and changes bonus-scatter behaviour from initial trigger (8/10/12/14 spins) to retrigger (3/5/8/10 respins).
consistency_check.implication_for_audit: One paytable applies to all spins. Theoretical RTP can be computed from per-reel weights × this paytable plus the bonus contribution (multiplier expectation × scatter trigger probability × free-spin RTP).
